definition.title: Controlled dependency recovery
steps: Provision only the isolated QA 777 prerequisites documented in docs/qa/777-residual-gaps.md.
Use isolated QA resources to interrupt worker/cache/search/storage paths during disposable operations and inspect retry/idempotence/read-back.
Record browser observations separately from supplemental protocol/automated assertions; retain exact runtime/config/definition provenance and every residual limitation.
definition.expected: Failures surface; supported retry paths recover without duplicate active records or corruption.

results.reason: Storage adapter still leaks its vendor connection exception (#783); in-flight ingestion worker crash and whole-search-engine outage were not exercised.
results.residual_risk: Ping task/adapter/index-block recovery is not certification of every document-ingestion crash or dependency failure.

evidence.description: Dedicated MinIO outage/restart preserved exact bytes and Chrome readiness recovered, but get leaked vendor exception (#783). New isolated clean-app worker/Redis: paused-worker ping queued once then drained, broker/cache outage failed promptly, restart restored ping plus ordered start/done. Own OpenSearch index write block yielded typed DependencyError; prior text unchanged, two retries left one updated chunk, ownhit1/foreign0. Exact worker/Redis containers and scratch index/pipeline removed after empty-queue/identity guards.
